entries.60ff9196da307526: This business manufactures and sells compound feed, mainly made from grains, for poultry, pigs, cattle, fish and others. It also buys and sells livestock products produced by its customers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥43,669 million. Feed is manufactured at the Kobe, Mihara, Kagoshima, Hachinohe and Sakaide plants, and part of the compound feed for cattle is contracted for manufacture to affiliate Michinoku Shiryo Co., Ltd.
entries.62da91f6aac88191: Through close information exchange, study sessions and technical guidance with customers at its five factories nationwide, the company deepens its relationships, and it has a research and development structure that collects and examines the latest information in Japan and overseas. For newly developed feed, the company conducts trial analysis at group farms and other sites, and works on research and development to meet customer needs.
entries.63186f7b8f86d5f1: There are two reportable segments: the Feed Business (net sales to external customers of ¥43,669 million) and the Livestock Business (¥1,910 million), with the Feed Business accounting for most of net sales. There are no net sales to external customers outside Japan, and there are no property, plant and equipment located outside Japan. No single external customer accounts for 10% or more of net sales.

entries.da4f4fe3765bec5d: This is a compound feed manufacturer with its head office in Higashinada Ward, Kobe, and the group consists of the company, 1 consolidated subsidiary and 1 affiliate. There are 2 reportable segments, the Feed Business and the Livestock Business, and the number of consolidated employees in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 179.
entries.daaf8d94559cac0d: Under the management principle of "customer first," the company aims to contribute to the development of the feed and livestock industries by stably supplying safe, high-quality compound feed to customers. For sustainable growth and higher corporate value in the Feed Business and the Livestock Business, the company states that, in addition to strengthening sales, it will focus on reducing fixed costs and production costs through equipment renewal and similar measures. As issues to address, the company cites focusing on reducing production costs, securing and developing diverse human resources, and preventing livestock diseases.
